cards.title: Who can do this
items: Any signed-in role: file cards, ratings, 'Start now', Skip, the path card and Files
Admin or owner: 'Add task', core file edits and deletes, 'Import store products'
Owner only: the WhatsApp card and the banner's 'Activate Noor'; the bar's link shows to every role
Members' launch path links lead to read-only pages

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Chat: 30 an hour and 150 a day per account (a trial 10 and 30), or past the plan's message allowance: the message goes back into the box, not counted
Files: 60 writes an hour, 200 KB per request, 200 files, 40,000 characters a file
A refused 'Add task' still shows 'Added' until reload
Import reads at most 25 product pages, only through safeFetch

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: 'Start now' gets 'The agents are paused for now…' and no credits are used
No tool runs and nothing is charged; the reserved message is given back; unpaused, the chat turn and its tools can charge credits
Import store products makes no model call and spends no credits
